# OMP NInfer

> Durable local inference for coding agents: the qualified local inference appliance for
> Oh My Pi. Your coding session should survive the process. Oh My Pi (coding-agent client) →
> OMP NInfer (qualified appliance and release layer) → NInfer (inference engine) → Qwen3.8 27B
> (served model). Community project; not affiliated with or endorsed by Oh My Pi, Qwen, or
> NVIDIA.

Qualified on RTX 5090 · 4090 · 3090 — **v0.19.0** (published 2026-11-13, GitHub Latest), stock
**Oh My Pi 18.20.0** (`c3089702`). The 0.x series supports only the latest published release and its
exact manifest and profiles.
- **RTX 5090 container lane:** Windows 11 + Docker Desktop/WSL2 on loopback `127.0.0.1:18089`
  (local Windows client, manual macOS SSH tunnel preview, or Linux x64 client under WSL2); `v0.7.0-qwen38-5090-beta.8` (source
  `41f89b31` on [`Neroued/ninfer`](https://github.com/Neroued/ninfer) master `64d10fbf`, image `c3ec151b` on reused base `28857182`, server `147da36b`), profile
  `qwen38-5090-v0.13.0` (config `751d22dc`, kept from v0.13.0), model container v3 `81f924d4` (20.4 GB, served model ID `q38-ninfer`), DFlash2 draft window
  7, BF16 KV (146,368 automatic tokens), 131,072-token context, two requests in flight, schema 3
  checkpoints (isolated host `checkpoints-v019` mounted at the profile's `/checkpoints-v013` container path, strict origin auth, memory-pressure checkpoint saves refused for capacity/I/O/superseded tag bounded to six retries or 10 s with one `pressure`/`abandoned` receipt while store-quota refusals remain immediate and terminal, GPU-staged durable checkpoint export when the host RAM cache is full, checkpoint preparation held until an active prefill/decode pass finishes, 4-turn fresh-request admission priority, bounded resume/fresh admission, host-cache reclaim of already-checkpointed generations, non-blocking export), JSON-schema output,
  128-character tool names, vision + tools.
- **RTX 4090 and RTX 3090 native Windows 11 lanes:** carried `v0.8.0-qwen38-4090-beta.3` (unchanged from `v0.18.0` at source `48c8ac46`, package
  `ac41700a`, server `a5266ae6`, profile `qwen38-4090-native-v0.8.0-beta.3`, build profile
  `native-v0.8.0-beta.3-rtx4090`, config `b71a2cff`, one active request / `C1`, 30 s pending
  timeout, 15,747.734375 MiB shared host RAM budget, 640 MiB admission headroom; without bounded pressure saves until it is re-cut at the next engine freeze) and
  rebuilt `v0.8.0-qwen38-3090-beta.4` (descendant source `15c3e395` with identical serve source to RTX 5090 `41f89b31`, package `62b9effd`, server `2c25588e`, profile
  `qwen38-3090-native-v0.8.0-beta.4`, build profile `native-v0.8.0-beta.4-tc-rtx3090` enabling
  `sm_86` tensor-core draft verification at 8- and 16-token verify widths `T=8/16`, config `6e4c6fc2`, two requests in flight / `C2`
  over one shared 131,072-token pool, 180 s pending timeout, `providers.maxInFlightRequests.ninfer-native-3090: 2` in
  `examples/manual-tunnel/fail-closed.yml`, 20,867.734375 MiB shared host RAM budget, 768 MiB admission
  headroom, 350 W serving cap, bounded retryable pressure-save refusals at six retries or 10 s; `Install-Release.ps1` stops a running `v0.8.0-qwen38-3090-beta.3`
  lane through its own controller and preserves it for `Control-Release.ps1 -Action Rollback`, while
  `Control-Release.ps1` restores the GPU-ownership lock if `-Action Stop` is refused) on loopback
  `127.0.0.1:18082` on `Neroued/ninfer` master
  `64d10fbf`, UUID-bound on one two-GPU host (sequential single-GPU serving, one lane at a time),
  shared model container v3 `81f924d4` (20.4 GB, `qwen3_8_27b-v3.ninfer`; served model IDs
  `qwen3.8-27b` on RTX 4090 and `q38-ninfer` on RTX 3090), DFlash2 draft window 7 (`K=7`,
  `proposal: "artifact-default"`, `Q4_G64_FP16` draft MLP, host-mapped `token_embedding`), INT8 KV,
  8-bit group-64 prefill activations (`Group64 A8`) and FP32 head logits off, 131,072-token context, 1,024-token prefill chunk, two extra
  device-state slots, schema 3 checkpoints (`session-checkpoints-v3`, strict origin auth),
  JSON-schema output, 128-character tool names, SPDX + CycloneDX dependency SBOMs, text + tools (no vision).
- **Proof:** Fresh v0.19.0 acceptance at commit `6b22f219` across all five quickstart routes
  (31 executable command blocks), all three stock Oh My Pi 18.20.0 client binaries (macOS arm64 preview, Windows x64, Linux x64
  under WSL2), and both RTX 4090 and RTX 3090 native Windows public-URL package installs, single- and two-request (`C1`/`C2`)
  probes, test-window checkpoint cleanup, and host restoration passed on their first attempts (owner-operated; 402.128 s RTX 5090, 517.0 s
  RTX 4090, and 1,339.4 s RTX 3090 test windows; on RTX 3090: 0 HTTP 503 responses, 0 queue timeouts, 0 checkpoint write errors, complete managed `Stop` shutdown with 0 refused sessions, 5/5 HTTP 200 on four-branch `C2` fanout, and 2/2 committed compactions in one session in proof `9759ea5f` inside [`rtx3090-public-install.json`](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/v0.19.0/releases/v0.19.0/acceptance/rtx3090-public-install.json)); RTX 5090 `beta.8` (`41f89b31`) and RTX 3090 `beta.4` `tc` (`15c3e395`) runtime qualifications are fresh while RTX 4090 `beta.3` (`48c8ac46`) carries its byte-identical `v0.18.0` component qualification (RTX
  5090 181.71 tok/s server decode and 56.67 s / 56.668 s cold exact 130,048-token retrieval; RTX 4090
  253.71 tok/s C1 decode and 83.45 s / 83.451 s exact retrieval; RTX 3090 `tc` 227.19 tok/s C1 decode and
  188.45 s / 188.453 s exact retrieval; RTX 3090 `tc` verified byte-identical to published `beta.3` `tc` across 80/80 deterministic prompts and 84/84 paired A/B/B/A speed-gate cases at weighted decode-speed ratio 0.9997× / minimum case 0.9975×).

- [Tagged quickstart](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/v0.19.0/docs/QUICKSTART.md): immutable installation guide for the current release
